title: DAGLFNet: Deep Feature Attention Guided Global and Local Feature Fusion for Pseudo-Image Point Cloud Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2510.10471v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Environmental perception systems are crucial for high-precision mapping and autonomous navigation, with LiDAR serving as a core sensor providing accurate 3D point cloud data. Efficiently processing unstructured point clouds while extracting structured semantic information remains a significant challenge. In recent years, numerous pseudo-image-based representation methods have emerged to balance efficiency and performance by fusing 3D point clouds with 2D grids. However, the fundamental inconsistency between the pseudo-image representation and the original 3D information critically undermines 2D-3D feature fusion, posing a primary obstacle for coherent information fusion and leading to poor feature discriminability. This work proposes DAGLFNet, a pseudo-image-based semantic segmentation framework designed to extract discriminative features. translated_title: DAGLFNet：深度特征注意力引导的全局与局部特征融合用于伪图像点云分割
translated_abstract: 环境感知系统对于高精度建图和自主导航至关重要，激光雷达作为核心传感器提供精确的三维点云数据。如何在高效处理非结构化点云的同时提取结构化语义信息仍然是一项重大挑战。近年来，出现了许多基于伪图像的表示方法，通过将三维点云与二维网格融合来平衡效率与性能。然而，伪图像表示与原始三维信息之间的根本不一致性严重削弱了2D-3D特征融合，构成了一致性信息融合的主要障碍，并导致特征判别能力较差。本工作提出了DAGLFNet，一个旨在提取判别性特征的基于伪图像的语义分割框架。它包含三个关键组件：首先，全局-局部特征融合编码
tldr: 提出DAGLFNet框架，通过深度特征注意力引导的全局与局部特征融合，解决伪图像表示与原始三维信息不一致导致的特征判别性差的问题，从而提升点云语义分割性能。
en_tdlr: DAGLFNet is proposed as a pseudo-image-based point cloud semantic segmentation framework that employs deep feature attention guided global-local feature fusion to overcome the inconsistency between pseudo-image representations and original 3D information, enabling extraction of more discriminative features.
